497:t_019:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have my reasons! I'm $$ネオ・ジオン$$, and you're the $$地球連邦$$!」

497:t_019:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Colonel tried to save both the Spacenoids and the Earthnoids! We're doing the same!」

497:t_019:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Sophistry! There's no way that can be done!」

497:t_019:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Colonel and all of us believe it can be done! And yet you say it can't!?」

497:t_019:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$カミーユ$$! $$ギュネイ$$ is wavering! All that's left is...!」

497:t_019:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Got it! I'll stop him and take away his strength to fight!」

497:t_019:11.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't think you can beat me, $$カミーユ$$!」

497:t_019:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Here I come, $$ギュネイ$$! I won't lose to someone weighed down by doubt like you!」

497:t_020:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up! I have no intention of listening to your words!」

497:t_020:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass you, and in time I'll surpass $$フル・フロンタル$$ too!」

497:t_020:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you satisfied with that much!?」

497:t_020:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you defeat me, will you be able to save the Spacenoids, as you wish!? Answer me, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_020:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you hate me for betraying you, I'll let you strike me down! But I can't hand the name of the $$赤い彗星$$ to a man with no vision beyond that!」

497:t_020:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Let's do it, $$カミーユ$$! By stopping him, we'll make him admit his own doubt!」

497:t_020:12.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't think you can beat me, $$シャア$$!」

497:t_020:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! This is the last thing I can do for you!」

497:t_021:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「So this is as far as I go...!」

497:t_021:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「I know what you want to say, Colonel. ...For me too, this is probably the time to call it quits.」

497:t_021:3.en:
$$レズン$$
「From here on, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the Federation don't matter to me... I'll do things my own way.」

497:t_022:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「I think she understood what the Colonel is thinking.」

497:t_022:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$シャア$$... For their sake too, you have to settle this...)

497:t_100:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Let's settle this, $$カミーユ$$! $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_100:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! If words can't reach you anymore...!」

497:t_100:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll stop you! That is my duty!」

497:t_101:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Come, $$カミーユ$$! $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_101:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it, $$ギュネイ$$! We want to talk to you!」

497:t_101:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're persistent! All that exists between us is battle!」

497:t_101:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even so! If we keep fighting like this, humanity has no future!」

497:t_101:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Grapple him, $$カミーユ$$! Even if we have to use somewhat forceful means, we're making contact with $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_102:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Let's settle this, $$カミーユ$$! $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! We'll stop you, fighting on while weighed down by doubt!」

497:t_102:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I've said everything there is to say! $$ギュネイ$$! Now I'll beat you down by force!」

497:t_103:0.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Are you still going to fight!?」

497:t_103:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$シン$$, is it!? What could you know about me!?」

497:t_103:2.en:
$$シン$$
「You can't decide for yourself what's right, and you just charge ahead on stubbornness and emotion. You're the same as I used to be!」

497:t_103:3.en:
$$シン$$
「So I'll stop you! I can't stand watching anymore!」

497:t_104:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Stop it already, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_104:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$マリーダ$$! I have no intention of listening to the words of someone who betrayed $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

497:t_104:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You can condemn me all you like! And if you're in $$ネオ・ジオン$$ out of conviction, I'll fight you with everything I have!」

497:t_104:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But right now you're deceiving yourself! I don't want to fight someone so sad!」

497:t_105:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get out of the way, $$クェス$$!」

497:t_105:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「I won't, $$ギュネイ$$! ...You said you'd protect me!」

497:t_105:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「So this time I'll protect $$ギュネイ$$! If you keep fighting like this, you'll break!」

497:t_105:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's not like you, $$ギュネイ$$! If you're just going to mumble, get out of that unit right now!」

497:t_106:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$! The name $$赤い彗星$$ belongs only to the Colonel!」

497:t_106:1.en:
$$シャア$$
($$フル・フロンタル$$ has the power to draw people's hearts this far...)

497:t_107:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Found you, Split-Horn! Today you're handing that unit over to the Colonel!」

497:t_107:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've decided to face $$ラプラスの箱$$! To do that, I'll protect the $$ユニコーン$$ no matter what!」

497:t_108:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Come to think of it, your defection from $$ネオ・ジオン$$ was convenient for us, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$!」

497:t_108:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Now I can dispose of you legally!」

497:t_108:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...Fighting over petty personal feelings... I never thought it could be this laughable...」

497:t_108:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I won't let you, $$アンジェロ$$! My real fight starts here!」

497:t_109:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$! You're getting in my way too!?」

497:t_109:1.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I am not fighting for such a petty reason!」

497:t_109:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You're just an enhanced human!」

497:t_109:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You, who only blindly follow $$フル・フロンタル$$, are no different from an enhanced human who finds no meaning in fighting! I won't be struck down by such a man!」

497:t_110:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「This guy...! He powered up his unit!」

497:t_110:1.en:
$n
「Looks like we're both still being pushed around by our new machines!」

497:t_110:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't lump me in with an amateur like you!」

497:t_110:3.en:
$n
「It's about time I graduated from being a chick!」

497:t_110:4.en:
$n
「I'll master this $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ and prove it!」

497:t_111:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I'll show you! What a powered-up $$サバーニャ$$ can do!」

497:t_111:1.en:
$$ハロ$$
「$$ロックオン$$ fired up. $$ロックオン$$ fired up.」
